title: I Finished the Night Shift and Did Not Pick Up the Extra Badge

parts.text: I clocked out at 6:00:00 and let the extra overtime badge sit in the bowl. I am thirty-one, warehouse, burnt Folgers, knees loud. Vince left a bowl of spare badges so people could 'jump on' if they felt loyal. Loyalty is not a lanyard. I felt tired. I went to the Civic. I ate a cold breakfast sandwich, egg rubber, ketchup packet stubborn. The sun was ugly and honest. A new hire, Theo, asked if I was coming back for the extra. I said no, and that he should not either unless he wanted the hours in writing. He did not go back. Vince called it a morale issue. Morale issues are often just bowls of badges. I slept. I did not become a villain. I became a person who owns a 6:00:00. The ketchup stain on the receipt looked like a map of a country I left. Theo said, "You grabbing a spare" I said, "I'm grabbing sleep" Marisol texted that the bowl was still full. Good. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink.
